description: MainActivity.java defines the main launcher activity for an Android app, providing a grid-based menu to access different samples or features within the app.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main launcher activity that displays a grid of sample items and handles item clicks to launch other activities.

classes.name: SampleAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for populating the GridView with sample items.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Data class representing a sample item with title, description, and intent.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the grid view and sample list.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on grid items to start the corresponding activity.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of sample items.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the sample item at a given position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for the item, based on its hash code.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view for a grid item and populates it with title and description.

methods.name: Sample (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a Sample object with resource IDs and intent.

methods.name: Sample (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a Sample object with resource IDs and activity class, creating an intent.
